description: This file contains test cases for shared utility functions related to daemon container context, runtime status color mapping, and hints rendering within the CLI component of the openclaw project. It uses the Vitest testing framework and imports functions from './shared.js'.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeStatusColor
methods.description: Maps runtime status strings to corresponding theme colors.

methods.name: renderGatewayServiceStartHints
methods.description: Generates hints for starting the gateway service based on environment variables.

methods.name: filterContainerGenericHints
methods.description: Filters out generic hints related to container environment when specific container environment variables are set.
